motivation: R47A7 proved the R47A6 witness is a full-CLV DP-only obstruction, but DP followed by R33 yields terminal or strict descent on pivots 1,3,5,7. Move the cheap producer boundary from DP-only to DP->R33 and attack exactly its complement class.

producer_contract.search_phase: scan variables deterministically; for each bipolar pivot compute exact DP plus subsumption, then R33 simplify; accept the first pivot whose R33 result is declared terminal or whose post-R33 CLV is strictly below input CLV
producer_contract.proof_authority: after selecting one pivot only, invoke canonical R45A macro_candidate_for_var and independent_macro_replay; selected pivot must be accepted and independently replayed
producer_contract.fallback: if no DP->R33 rescue exists, retain RUP/full R45A fallback

complement_hunt.universe: deterministic one-clause replacement neighborhood of the frozen R47A6 witness over the full 7-variable 3-clause universe
complement_hunt.eligibility: R33 STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE, zero original R33 rule applications, unchanged original formula, bipolar
complement_hunt.true_DP_R33_obstruction: for every pivot: post-DP R33 remains STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE and post-R33 CLV >= input CLV
complement_hunt.if_found: run affine, RUP independent replay, and full R45A to locate the next rescue layer
